sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 377)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and syndication, six inspiring philosophical essays on Edward R. Murrow's *This I Believe* featuring coal industrialist George R. Higginbotham, *Christmas Seals* pioneer Leigh Mitchell Hodges, Worcester Mayor Andrew B. Holmstrom, Mexican scholar Antonio Iglesias, Superior Court Judge William F. James, and educator Dr. Galen Jones (1952):
